name: Guest – Guest FB Content Generator v6 [LLaMA3.1]

parameters.content:
## JeroPC Local Setup — v6 (LLaMA 3.1 Optimized)

**AnythingLLM**
- Base URL: http://localhost:3001
- AuthAPI Key: YOUR_ANYTHINGLLM_API_KEY
- Endpoint: /api/v1/workspace/content-planner/chat
- Model: Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Q8_0

**ComfyUI**
- API URL: http://localhost:8188
- Image model: z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors

**Facebook Page**
- Page ID: YOUR_FB_PAGE_ID
- Page Access Token: YOUR_FB_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN

**Telegram**
- Bot HTTP API: YOUR_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
- User Chat ID: YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID

nodes.name: Facebook – Upload Photo (Unpublished)
nodes.notes: Step 1 of 2: uploads photo unpublished so we control post creation explicitly in the next node, avoiding Facebook auto-bundling multiple photo uploads into one grouped post.

parameters.name: reply_markup
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inline_keyboard: [[ { text: '✅ Approve', callback_data: 'approve_' + $json.chatId }, { text: '❌ Reject', callback_data: 'reject_' + $json.chatId } ]] }) }}

nodes.name: Facebook – Publish to Feed
nodes.notes: Step 2 of 2: explicitly creates one standalone Post per photo via /feed + attached_media, so Facebook cannot silently fold this into a previous post.
